scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,client,admin -c blue,green,magenta "yarn workspace @dctd/api start:dev" "yarn workspace @dctd/client dev" "yarn workspace @dctd/admin dev"
scripts.contracts:generate: yarn workspace @dctd/api openapi:generate && yarn workspace @dctd/client generate:api && yarn workspace @dctd/admin generate:api
scripts.contracts:check: yarn contracts:generate && git diff --exit-code -- api/openapi document/api client/src/generated admin/src/generated
scripts.build: yarn contracts:generate && yarn workspace @dctd/api build && yarn workspace @dctd/client build && yarn workspace @dctd/admin build
scripts.test: yarn workspace @dctd/api test && yarn workspace @dctd/client test && yarn workspace @dctd/admin test
scripts.lint: yarn workspace @dctd/api lint && yarn workspace @dctd/client lint && yarn workspace @dctd/admin lint
scripts.verify: yarn lint && yarn test && yarn build
